== Course of events ==

With Queen Jinjur's rebellion collapsing after Mombi's confession revealed Tip's true identity as Princess Ozma, the Army of Revolt lays down its arms in the Emerald City. The surrender brings an end to the uprising, and the jewels the rebels had stolen are handed back. In the wake of this resolution, Tip stands revealed and Ozma is crowned queen of the Emerald City, restoring rightful rule to the throne that Jinjur had seized.

The events that follow flow directly from this restoration of order. Freed from the crisis, the Gump asks to be taken apart again into its original pieces, and Ozma, now queen, grants the request. The Emerald City, no longer under threat, settles into the aftermath of the surrender as its new sovereign takes charge.
